arabic_text: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
english_translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
question: What is the correct translation of the Arabic phrase 'حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ' from this Hadith?

options.A: Until he loves Allah more than himself
options.B: Until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself
options.C: Until he prays for his brother as he prays for himself
options.D: Until he gives charity to his brother from his wealth
